_note: Frozen reference anchors for the adversarial suite. Values were fetched once and copied here verbatim; the suite never refetches. Fixed-point scales come from devnode /engine/v1/intents/<id> (read 2026-11-08 15:4x UTC).

FX_NOW.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (data-api.ecb.europa.eu, series EXR.D.{USD,CAD,SEK}.EUR.SP00.A)
FX_NOW.licence: ECB statistics; reuse terms not confirmed by fetch on 2026-11-08 (see README limits)
FX_NOW.intent_shape: rate = {key} per USD, decimals 6, range [0.0001, 100000]; unit alias 'USD per {key}' means inverse

CRYPTO_PRICE.source: CoinGecko public API /api/v3/simple/price (ids bitcoin, ethereum, solana, binancecoin, ripple; vs usd)
CRYPTO_PRICE.licence: CoinGecko API terms (coingecko.com/en/api_terms, read 2026-11-08): use requires the attribution 'Powered by CoinGecko'. Not an open licence.
CRYPTO_PRICE.intent_shape: price_usd in US dollars, range [0.000001, 10000000]; on-chain layout has no decimals (ready:false), so the suite assumes 6 decimals and adds 8- and 18-decimal slices

WEATHER_CHECK.licence: CC BY 4.0 (open-meteo.com/en/terms, read 2026-11-08). Attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com
WEATHER_CHECK.intent_shape: temp_c in degrees Celsius, decimals 6, range [-90, 60]
